title: Paginate the products list
body:
## Summary

GET /api/products now supports page and limit query parameters and returns a paged object.

## Changes

* list returns items, page, limit and total
* Default page size is 10

## How to test

Call GET /api/products?page=1&limit=2.

verixa_should_cover: page and limit return the right slice
page 0 or negative page is handled
Response shape changed from array to object, so the demo page and Newman collection break (BUG: not updated)
Category filter still works with pagination
